subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

CONGENIAL
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mean**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Congenial** means pleasant to spend time with because their interests and character are similar to your own.

 
 
• **Example -** *Mark is a **congenial** host who always makes everyone feel welcome.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Mean** refers to a person who has to put people down to make themselves feel good about themself.
 
 
• **Example -** *But she wasn't a **mean** person; she was fickle and she could be cold.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that **'Congenial'** and **'Mean'** are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Merciful** means to describe someone who has compassion for other people, especially when he is in a position to punish them or treat them.
 
• **Mellow** means a person's character tempered by maturity or experience.
 
• **Mild** means gentle and not easily provoked.
